name: Folia Label Helper
description: Drive Palmstreet's USPS label flow from a Folia work queue. Reads weight from a USB scale, captures label + slip PDFs, syncs tracking back. Watches the seller live dashboard and logs the whole show (sold lots, prices, bids) for the Mac app's Show monitor. During a live, shows the streamer an on-page overlay: viewers, sales pace, the lot on the block, and VIP buyers (from shipping history) as they join.
